# PasswordInput

```ts
import { PasswordInput } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Password Input is a password-creation field composed from Input Label, Radix's accessible password toggle, Helper String, and Password Menu. Use it when the form should expose password policy guidance as the user types; use Text Input for non-secret values and PIN Input for a fixed numeric credential.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text above the field (renders an InputLabel, wired via htmlFor). |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label's 16px info icon. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Appends "(required)" to the label and sets the native required attribute. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Helper text below the input (renders a HelperString). |
| `status` | `PasswordStatus` | `'default'` | Validation state: semantic chrome and helper tone. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled password value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Uncontrolled initial password value. |
| `onChange` | `React.ChangeEventHandler<HTMLInputElement>` | — | Fires with the native input change event. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Fires with the raw password value whenever it changes. |
| `onVisibilityChange` | `(visible: boolean) => void` | — | Fires when the Radix visibility toggle changes state. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | — | Controlled visibility for the password. |
| `defaultVisible` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial visibility. |
| `showStrengthMenu` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the PasswordMenu while the field or its eye toggle has focus. |
| `strength` | `PasswordStrength` | — | Overrides automatically calculated password strength. |
| `strengthLabel` | `string` | — | Overrides the visible PasswordMenu strength label. |
| `requirements` | `PasswordRequirement[]` | — | Overrides the default password-policy requirements in PasswordMenu. |
| `metRequirementIds` | `string[]` | — | Satisfied custom-policy requirement ids; defaults to the built-in rule checks. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'size' | 'type' | 'onChange' | 'value' | 'defaultValue'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<PasswordInput label="Enter password" placeholder="Choose a password" />
<PasswordInput label="New password" required showLabelInfo />
<PasswordInput label="Password" autoComplete="current-password" showStrengthMenu={false} />
<PasswordInput label="Password" status="error" helperText="Invalid password" />
<PasswordInput label="Password" defaultValue="CorrectHorse1" status="success" />
<PasswordInput aria-label="New password" />
```

## Accessibility

- Supply label, or supply aria-label for a labelless field. Input Label is a real <label htmlFor>, so clicking it focuses the password input.
- Radix provides a real button that toggles masked/revealed type, with an updated “Show password” / “Hide password” accessible name.
- status="error" sets aria-invalid; helper text is associated through aria-describedby; required is both visibly communicated and native.
- Focus uses the primary border for the entire field and a tokenized ring for the eye action. Disabled inputs and toggles are not interactive.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use a visible label and keep the requirements aligned with submit validation. | Treat the strength display as server-side password validation. |
| Let Password Menu open while users create a password. | Show strength guidance for a current-password sign-in field unless needed. |
| Use status="error" plus explanatory helper text for a rejected password. | Rely on the red field treatment without explaining the failure. |
| Provide custom requirements and metRequirementIds together for a custom policy. | Reuse the built-in requirement ids for an unrelated policy. |
